children: CytoSorbents regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement after 10 consecutive trading days at or above $1.00.
Nasdaq confirmed on Sept 22, 2026 that CytoSorbents met Rule 5550(a)(2) via 10 consecutive sessions ending Sept 21, 2026; matter closed.
Company remains noncompliant with Nasdaq MVLS $35M requirement and has until Dec 28, 2026 to regain compliance for 10 consecutive business days.
CytoSorbents is evaluating actions to regain MVLS compliance, including options to increase stockholders’ equity to at least $2.5M.
If compliance is not regained by Dec 28, 2026, Nasdaq may notify the company of delisting and CytoSorbents may appeal the determination.
Management reiterated focus on driving CytoSorb sales, achieving operating cash-flow breakeven in H2 2026, advancing DrugSorb-ATR toward FDA approval, and unlocking asset value.
